rationale:
What I changed: 23 Nov is now an easy 6 km instead of rest, with Tue and Sat trimmed by 2 km each so the week lands ~56 km rather than jumping; and 9 Nov (tomorrow) is a bike option rather than a pure rest. What I didn't change: tomorrow stays run-free. You're right that you're not tired - HRV/RHR are flat and that was never the reason. The reason is the calf: on 1 Nov it was fine in the warm-up and tightened inside 0.8 km, and the load response of calf and tendon lags 24-48 h, so Sunday's run hasn't fully reported yet. A third run in three days adds no fitness at 6 km and risks the one thing that matters; the bike keeps you moving. Once a clear week of running is banked, rest days become a fitness question rather than a calf one, and I'm happy to trade them for easy runs. 13 and 16 Nov stay as planned: the step to ~58 km that week is already the load rise.

Original: hold; two clean easy runs support the rebuild but are not yet a calf-clear week. 23-29 Nov volume holds ~56 km while strides return; tempo waits until 5 Dec at the earliest.
